metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting a fly and got 1 baffling kill?! Valorant aim is broken again
metadata.description:
Clicked like my hand was on autopilot.
Enemy probably thinking about uninstalling.
Pretending I meant that for 0.13 seconds.
Click if your aim’s a complete mystery but the game still hands you a kill!

Tap if your aim’s a happy accident but the kills keep coming!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
